title: Generator vanishing for the signed column projection differential
statement: Let C be an abelian category admitting total complexes for all first-quadrant bicomplexes, let A and B be first-quadrant bicomplexes in C, f:A → B a morphism, p a natural number and n an integer. Put M=Cone(extend(Tot(f))), T=Cone(extend(f at column p))[-p], and R_n=coneHorizontalProjection f p n [def-sp-cone-horizontal-projection]. For every natural h≥p, let s_h=coneHorizontalSummand A h (n+1) followed by the source inclusion into M in degree n, and t_h=coneHorizontalSummand B h n followed by the target inclusion into M in degree n [lem-sp-cone-horizontal-step-stable]. Then both s_h followed by (R_n followed by d_T minus d_M followed by R_(n+1)) and t_h followed by the same defect are zero. No filtration or quotient is assumed.

Apply horizontalProjection_tail_differential to the source-total differential block and horizontalProjection_naturality to the f block. The shift coefficient is (-p).negOnePow=(-1)^p, and (-1)^p times itself is 1, so the two composites agree.

lean.statement:
theorem coneHorizontal_projection_generator_vanishing
    {A B : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (p : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    (∀ h : ℕ, p ≤ h →
      (coneHorizontalSummand A h (n + 1) ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.inlX
          (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
            ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) (n + 1) n rfl) ≫
        (coneHorizontalProjection f p n ≫
          ((CochainComplex.mappingCone
            (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (f.f p)
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))⟦-(p : ℤ)⟧).d n (n + 1) -
          (CochainComplex.mappingCone
            (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).d n (n + 1) ≫
            coneHorizontalProjection f p (n + 1)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ h : ℕ, p ≤ h →
      (coneHorizontalSummand B h n ≫
        (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr
          (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
            ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).f n) ≫
        (coneHorizontalProjection f p n ≫
          ((CochainComplex.mappingCone
            (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (f.f p)
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))⟦-(p : ℤ)⟧).d n (n + 1) -
          (CochainComplex.mappingCone
            (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).d n (n + 1) ≫
            coneHorizontalProjection f p (n + 1)) = 0)
